blocks.h2: When to Call an Evanston Drain Plumber
blocks.body: Call when plunging hasn't worked, the same drain clogs again within weeks or you notice a sewer smell. If only one fixture is slow, the clog is in that branch. If several drains are slow, or water rises at the basement floor drain, the main line is blocked and needs [sewer cleaning](/evanston/sewer-rodding).

img.alt: Illustration of common signs a drain needs professional cleaning

blocks.h2: Kitchen Sink Drain Unclogging in Evanston
bodies: Kitchen sinks are the drain Evanston homeowners call us about most. Grease, food scraps and soap build up together and harden inside the pipe, especially in older homes where the kitchen drain runs a long way to the stack.

We clear the line with a cable sized for kitchen pipe, check that the dishwasher and disposal drain properly and tell you what caused it. If grease keeps coming back, [hydro jetting](/evanston/hydro-jetting) cleans the whole pipe wall. If the disposal is the problem, see [garbage disposal repair](/evanston/garbage-disposal-installation-repair).
Hair and soap in the bathroom and lint from the laundry cause most other clogs. We clear them and show you what came out.
Many older Evanston homes still have galvanized or cast iron drains that narrow with age. If a drain keeps clogging, we'll camera it to see whether the pipe needs cleaning or replacing.

blocks.h2: Why Drains Clog in Evanston Homes
blocks.intro: About 4 in 10 Evanston homes were built before 1940.

items.body: Older layouts send kitchen water a long way, with plenty of room for grease to settle.
When every drain is slow, the main is blocked. See [sewer drain clearing](#sewer-drain-clearing).

bodies: When the basement floor drain backs up or every drain slows at once, the main sewer drain is blocked. We clear it from the cleanout to the city sewer.

Then we camera it so you see the cause, usually roots in old clay. If it keeps happening, we'll go over [rodding](/evanston/sewer-rodding), [jetting](/evanston/hydro-jetting) or a [repair](/evanston/sewer-repair).

blocks.h2: Drain Cleaning Questions From Evanston Homeowners

items.q: Can you unclog my kitchen sink today?
items.preview: Often, and our line is open 24/7.
items.answer: Often, yes. Call any time and we'll get a plumber to you as soon as we can.

items.q: Why does my kitchen sink keep clogging?
items.answer: Usually grease that has coated the pipe. Clearing the clog opens a path, while jetting removes the buildup.

items.q: Why does my dishwasher drain into the sink?
items.preview: The kitchen drain is partly blocked.
items.answer: When the kitchen drain or disposal is partly clogged, dishwasher water backs up into the sink.

items.q: Should I use a chemical drain cleaner?
items.answer: We don't recommend it, especially on older pipe. It rarely clears grease and can damage the pipe.

items.q: How do I keep my kitchen sink from clogging?
items.answer: Wipe greasy pans with a paper towel before washing, use a strainer and run hot water after the dishwasher drains.

items.q: How much does drain cleaning cost in Evanston?
items.preview: It depends on where the clog is. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on where the clog is and what's causing it. You'll approve a flat price before we start.
